File no. 006 · From your peak twin

A letter, just for you.

Some things deserve more than a quick birthday message.

✉

Kikuchii has one unopened letter waiting.

Dear Kikuchii, Happy Birthday, Kikuchi! It's funny to think that this whole friendship began with a simple “Nice to meet you bro.” I had no idea that one little conversation would turn into so many memories and moments I'd want to keep forever. And don't worry, I'll be there for you whenever you need me — when you're sad, when you're happy, when you're crying and when you're laughing, just like I've been for the past 1 year hehe. Thank you for being you. Thank you for all the laughs, the chaos, the random conversations and all the little things that make this friendship so special. I'm genuinely glad our paths crossed. I hope this year is kind to you. May it bring you peaceful days, exciting surprises, confidence in yourself and countless reasons to smile. 🥺🤍 I hope we get to make many more memories and look back at them years from now. Happy Birthday, Kikuchii. Here's to many more awesome yearssss! 🤍 — Your bestie, Zoro P.S. You're stuck with me. The archive has receipts.
